propositions: Version numbers must be bumped in lockstep across pyproject.toml (1 occurrence) and server.json (2 occurrences: top-level + single packages[] entry) for 0.10.1 release.
CHANGELOG.md must be updated with a curated [0.10.1] section and correct compare-link footer via 'make changelog VERSION=v0.10.1'.
Release commit must pass local gates (lint, typecheck, test) and artifact validation (python -m build && twine check dist/*) before pushing to Gerrit.
Release commit must be merged to origin/main through Gerrit with both LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 votes and MERGED status.
0.10.1 must be published to PyPI (verified via curl to pypi.org/pypi/nava-rebar/json) and released on GitHub with v0.10.1 tag at the merged main SHA.
Post-release verification must confirm smoke test (rebar --help) and artifact integrity with correct build COMMIT metadata.
